title: Room form
purpose: Create a room within a site or change the name of an existing room.
summary: Create a room within a site or change the name of an existing room.

tasks.title: Create a room
steps: Choose the [[Site]], type the [[Code]] and [[Name]], and select [[Create room]].

tasks.title: Rename a room
steps: Change the [[Name]], give the [[Reason for the change]] and select [[Save changes]].

good_to_know: The site and code cannot be changed later.
Codes are unique within the site, stored in capitals and never reused.
Rooms cannot be retired or deleted.

sections.title: Fields
paragraphs: Only the admin and manager roles can open or submit this form.

items.label: Site
items.description: Create only. Required; active sites only. Preselected when opened from a site page.

items.label: Code
items.description: Create only. Unique within the site. Up to 40 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit. Stored in capitals. It can never be changed or reused, even after retirement.

items.label: Reason for the change
items.description: Edit only. Required, up to 2000 characters. Kept in the history.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Editing needs a reason (up to 2000 characters), which is kept in the history with the values before and after. Creating records the setup without asking for a reason. If the record changed since you opened the form, the save is refused with a message to reload; your entries stay on the page, but check the current values before saving again. A save with nothing changed is refused.
